sources.fullCitation: Ilja Livschakoff Tanz-Orchester, with German refrain vocal by L. Monosson. “Süße Mamsell, denkst du noch an das kleine Hotel.” Tango; words by Fritz Rotter; music by Bronisław Kaper. Grammophon B 51043, Bestell-Nr. 23179, side 2, n.d. [not before 1930]. Label visible via Radiomuseum Hardthausen / Schallarchiv online upload.

sources.fullCitation: Ilja Livschakoff Tanzorchester. “Ein Lied aus meiner Heimat.” Slowfox; Polydor, Katalog-Nr. 24604, 1932. The upload gives the matrix number 4735 BD VII, names the film Melodie der Liebe as the source of the song, credits the music to Bronislaw Kaper and Walter Jurmann, and dates the recording to Berlin, about May 1932. Discographic detail as given in the uploader's description; the label is not shown in the YouTube upload.
